footnote_text: Represents a grant of Restricted Stock Units ("RSU's") under an inducement grant approved by the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors in reliance of an exception granted under Section 711 of the NYSE Amercian Company Guide.  100,000 of these RSU's shall vest on the six-month anniversary of the grant date, 25,000 shall vest on the one year anniversary of the grant date, 125,000 shall vest on the second anniversary of the grant date and the remainder on the third anniversary of the grant date.
